Came back twice in one day lol

Not gonna lie, we only wanted coffee at first. Then we ended up eating lunch... and came back again for dinner 😂 Morning crew felt more cheerful than the evening shift, but everyone was polite enough. Early July was packed with tourists around town but this place still felt relaxed.

Hong Kong, China8 contributions

Memorable stay
Jul 2024 • Family
The touristic information center of Sapa recommended this venue to us, and it turned out to be very much up to its reputation. The hotel and restaurant are perfectly located. They offer a very cozy environment, fine-taste interior decoration, and very clean, comfortable, and carefully maintained rooms. The design features a harmonious mix of East and West aesthetics. The terrace of the restaurant provides an excellent view over the square. The candid and very helpful staff are always welcoming with genuine smiles. I would recommend this venue to all my friends planning to visit Sapa.
Insider tip:
The pizza portion is very big, enough for a full meal, or to be share with your family
